# Casdoor

> Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) platform written in Go. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, RADIUS and Kerberos, includes an MCP server, and acts as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP servers and AI agents.

## The basics

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/overview/): Casdoor Overview
- [Core concepts](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/core-concepts/): Organizations, users, applications, and providers—the main building blocks of Casdoor.
- [Server installation](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/server-installation/): Install and configure the Casdoor server from source or pre-built binaries.
- [Configuration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/configuration/): Configure the Casdoor backend and frontend via app.conf and Conf.js.
- [Try with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/try-with-docker/): Run Casdoor using Docker or Docker Compose for quick testing or production.
- [Try with Helm](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/try-with-helm/): Deploy Casdoor on Kubernetes using Helm for manageable, scalable deployments.
- [Public API](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/public-api/): Authenticate and call the Casdoor REST API from your apps and scripts.
- [Tutorials](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/basic/tutorials/): Third-party product docs and articles that use Casdoor for SSO or auth.

## Comparisons

- [Casdoor vs. alternatives](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/comparison/overview/): How Casdoor compares with Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0, and Logto on language, license, protocols, AI agent and MCP support, and operations.
- [Casdoor vs. Keycloak](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-keycloak/): A practical comparison of Casdoor and Keycloak - architecture, protocols, customization, AI agent and MCP support, operations, and how to migrate users from Keycloak.
- [Casdoor vs. Authentik](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-authentik/): Casdoor and Authentik compared for self-hosted SSO - architecture, flows and UI customization, protocols, reverse-proxy authentication, licensing, and AI agent support.
- [Casdoor vs. Auth0](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-auth0/): Casdoor compared with Auth0 - open source and self-hosting versus a managed service, pricing model, data residency, customization, and AI agent and MCP support.
- [Casdoor vs. Logto](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-logto/): Casdoor and Logto compared - language and license, databases, protocols, multi-tenancy, enterprise directory features, and authentication for AI agents and MCP servers.

## LLM

- [OpenClaw](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/llm/openclaw/): Collect LLM agent traces, metrics, and logs in Casdoor using the OpenClaw observability agent.
- [MCP security](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/llm/mcp-security/): How Casdoor secures MCP deployments — OAuth 2.1 for access control and OpenTelemetry for audit and observability.

- [Deploying with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/docker/): Run Casdoor with Docker or Docker Compose and optional reverse proxies.
- [Deploying behind Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/nginx/): Put Nginx in front of the Casdoor backend to serve and proxy traffic.
- [Deploying to Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/k8s/): Deploy Casdoor in a Kubernetes cluster using the example manifests.
- [Data initialization](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/data-initialization/): Initialize or migrate Casdoor data using JSON config files.
- [Hosting static files in a CDN](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/deploy-cdn/): Deploy Casdoor frontend static assets to a CDN using a storage provider.
- [Hosting static files on an intranet](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/deploy-intranet/): Serve Casdoor static assets from an intranet-accessible URL.
- [Database migration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/db-migration/): How Casdoor handles database schema and data migrations.
- [Version information](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/deployment/version-info/): How Casdoor reports its version for binaries, Docker, and git builds.

## Connecting to Casdoor

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/overview/): Connect your application to Casdoor using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, or CAS.
- [Standard OIDC client](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/oidc-client/): Connect to Casdoor with any OIDC client using discovery endpoints.
- [Casdoor SDKs](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/sdk/): Use Casdoor SDKs for frontend and backend integration with user management and more.
- [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/session/single-sign-on/): Let users sign in once and access all apps in the organization without signing in again.
- [Single sign-out (SSO logout)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/session/single-sign-out/): Log users out from all applications in the organization at once.
- [RP-initiated logout](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/session/rp-initiated-logout/): Log a user out of Casdoor from a relying party using the OIDC RP-Initiated Logout endpoint.
- [Vue SDK](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/vue-sdk/): Use Casdoor in Vue 2 or Vue 3 with the official Vue SDK.
- [Electron app](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/electron-app/): Integrate Casdoor in an Electron app with OAuth and a custom protocol.
- [.NET desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/dotnet-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a .NET desktop app with WebView2.
- [.NET MAUI app](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/maui-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a .NET MAUI app (Android, Windows, etc.) with OpenID Connect.
- [Qt desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/qt-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a Qt (C++) desktop app with WebEngine.
- [React Native app](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-sdks/react-native-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a React Native app with the official SDK.
- [Casdoor CLI](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/cli/): Using Casdoor's official command-line interface for managing users, groups, and permissions
- [Plugins and middlewares](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/plugin/): Official Casdoor plugins for Spring Boot, WordPress, Odoo, Django, and Chrome.
- [Chrome extension](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/chrome-extension/): Integrate Casdoor OAuth in a Chrome extension.
- [Next.js](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/nextjs/): Integrate Casdoor in a Next.js app with middleware and the JS SDK.
- [Nuxt](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/nuxt/): Integrate Casdoor in a Nuxt app with middleware and the JS SDK.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/oauth/): Obtain, verify, and use access tokens with Casdoor’s OAuth 2.0 endpoints.
- [Guest authentication](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/guest-auth/): Create temporary users without credentials and upgrade them later.
- [Kerberos/SPNEGO authentication](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/kerberos/): Configure Kerberos/SPNEGO (Integrated Windows Authentication) for single sign-on.
- [Casdoor as a CAS server](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/cas/): Use Casdoor as a Central Authentication Service (CAS) server for CAS 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0.
- [SAML IdP overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/overview/): Use Casdoor as a SAML 2.0 identity provider.
- [AWS Client VPN (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/aws/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for AWS Client VPN.
- [Keycloak (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/keycloak/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP in Keycloak.
- [Google Workspace (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/google-workspace/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Google Workspace SSO.
- [Appgate (SAML POST)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/appgate/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Appgate SDP (POST SAMLResponse).
- [Tencent Cloud (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/saml/tencent-cloud/): Use Casdoor as SAML IdP for Tencent Cloud CAM.
- [MCP server overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/overview/): Use Casdoor’s MCP server for programmatic access via JSON-RPC 2.0.
- [MCP authentication](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authentication/): OAuth discovery and authentication methods for the MCP server.
- [MCP tools reference](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/tools/): List and call MCP tools (applications and more).
- [MCP authorization and scopes](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authorization/): Scope-based access control for MCP tools.
- [MCP integration example](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/integration/): Python example: scoped token and MCP tool calls.
- [MCP error handling](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/error-handling/): JSON-RPC error codes and responses from the MCP server.
- [MCP troubleshooting](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/troubleshooting/): Common MCP and OAuth issues and how to debug them.
- [Connect Claude Desktop to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-claude-desktop/): Connect Claude Desktop to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Connect Cursor to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-cursor/): Connect Cursor IDE to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Connect ChatGPT to MCP](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-chatgpt/): Connect ChatGPT to Casdoor’s MCP server with OAuth.
- [Face ID](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/face-id/): Sign in with Face ID using face-api.js.
- [WebAuthn](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/how-to-connect/webauthn/): Sign in with WebAuthn (passkeys, fingerprint, face, security keys).

## Organizations

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/overview/): Organizations are the core unit in Casdoor for managing users and applications.
- [Organization tree](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/organization-tree/): User groups and group hierarchy within an organization.
- [Password complexity](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/passwordComplexity/): Configure password strength rules per organization.
- [Password obfuscator](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/passwordObfuscator/): Encrypt password parameters in login and set-password APIs.
- [Account customization](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/accountCustomization/): Control visibility and edit permissions for each user account field.
- [Customize theme](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/customize-theme/): Set primary color and border radius at global, organization, or application level.
- [MFA items](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/organization/mfa-items/): Configure which MFA methods are available and whether they are optional or required.

## Applications

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/overview/): Learn how applications work in Casdoor and how to configure authentication for your services.
- [Application terminology](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/terminology/): Reference for application configuration fields and options, organized by tab.
- [Application configuration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/config/): Configure authentication and callback URLs for your Casdoor applications.
- [Dynamic client registration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/dynamic-client-registration/): Register OAuth clients programmatically via RFC 7591 (DCR).
- [Application categories](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/categories/): Default (user-facing) vs Agent (M2M) applications and their types.
- [Custom scopes](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/scopes/): Define custom OAuth scopes for Agent applications (e.g. MCP servers).
- [Providers](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/providers/): Attach providers to your application and set rules (signup, login, forgot password, MFA, etc.).
- [Sign-in methods](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/signin-methods/): Configure which sign-in methods are available and their order on the login page.
- [Exclusive sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/exclusive-signin/): Allow only one active session per user per application.
- [Sign-up items table](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/signup-items-table/): Configure signup items to build a custom registration page.
- [Sign-in items table](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/signin-items-table/): Configure signin items to build a custom sign-in page.
- [Login UI customization](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/ui-customization/): Customize the sign-in page: background, panel style, position, and side panel.
- [Specify login organization](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/specify-login-organization/): Let users choose or enter the organization on the sign-in page.
- [Application tags](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/tags/): Restrict sign-in to users whose tags match the application’s tags.
- [Invitation codes](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/invitation-code/): Restrict application sign-up to users with a valid invitation code.
- [Shared application](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/application/shared-application/): Use one application across multiple organizations with org-specific client IDs.

- [MCP auth setup](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/mcp-auth/setup/): Configure Casdoor as the OAuth server for your MCP server.
- [Third-party MCP server integration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/mcp-auth/third-party-integration/): Runnable code examples for MCP servers using Casdoor OAuth (Python, Node.js, Go).
- [Public MCP Server Registry](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/mcp-auth/mcp-registry/): A curated registry of publicly available MCP servers, with a web UI and machine-readable JSON API.

## Permissions

- [Permission configuration](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/permission/permission-configuration/): Configure Casbin permission policies and each field on the Edit Permission page.
- [Exposed Casbin APIs](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/permission/exposed-casbin-apis/): Call Casbin from your backend to enforce and manage permissions.
- [Adapter](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/permission/adapter/): Connect Casbin policy storage (database) and manage policies in the UI.

- [Face ID overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/faceid/overview/): Use Face ID as a sign-in method.
- [Alibaba Cloud FaceBody](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/faceid/alibaba_cloud_facebody/): Use Alibaba Cloud FaceBody for face verification.
- [ID verification provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/idv/overview/): Verify user identity via third-party ID verification (KYC) providers.
- [Jumio ID verification](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/idv/jumio/): Use Jumio as an ID verification (KYC) provider in Casdoor.
- [Alibaba Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/idv/alibaba-cloud/): Integrate Alibaba Cloud for ID card verification
- [Log providers](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/log/overview/): Collect OS logs, SELinux audit events, OpenTelemetry data, and permission audit events into Casdoor Entry records.
- [Scan provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/scan/overview/): Scan networks and web targets to discover servers or security issues, e.g. for MCP or vulnerability scanning.
- [MCP Scan](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/scan/mcp/): Scan intranet address ranges to discover MCP servers.
- [Security Scan](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/provider/scan/security/): Fingerprint web targets and report matching known vulnerabilities (CVEs).

## SaaS management

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/overview/): Use Casdoor for subscription and pricing: plans, payments, and subscriptions.
- [Product](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/products/product/): Define products (or services) to sell and attach payment providers.
- [Product store](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/products/product-store/): Publish products to a storefront where users can browse and purchase
- [Shopping cart](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/products/cart/): Collect multiple products before purchasing them together
- [Payment](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/products/payment/): View payment records, states, and issue invoices.
- [Order](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/products/order/): Track and manage product purchases with orders
- [Plan](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/plan/): Define a plan’s features and price; plans are tied to roles and products.
- [Pricing](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/): Group one or more plans so users can sign up at different price points.
- [Subscription](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/subscription/): Manage a user’s selected plan and application access.
- [Transaction](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/transaction/): Track payments and balance changes for users and organizations.
- [Coupon](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/pricing/coupon/): Create discount coupons and apply them to orders at checkout.

## Syncer

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/overview/): Sync users from external systems (databases, Azure AD, Keycloak, etc.) into Casdoor.
- [Database syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/Database/): Sync user data from an external database into Casdoor.
- [Azure AD syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/AzureAD/): Sync users from Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID) to Casdoor via Microsoft Graph.
- [Active Directory syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/ActiveDirectory/): Sync users from Microsoft Active Directory to Casdoor via LDAP/LDAPS.
- [Google Workspace syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/GoogleWorkspace/): Sync users from Google Workspace to Casdoor via the Admin SDK Directory API.
- [Keycloak syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/Keycloak/): Sync users from Keycloak to Casdoor with automatic schema mapping.
- [Okta syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/Okta/): Sync users from Okta to Casdoor via the Okta Users API.
- [SCIM 2.0 syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/SCIM/): Pull users into Casdoor from any SCIM 2.0-compliant identity provider.
- [AWS IAM syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/AWSIAM/): Sync users and groups from AWS IAM into Casdoor.
- [WeCom syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/WeCom/): Sync users from WeCom (企业微信) to Casdoor via the WeCom API.
- [DingTalk syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/DingTalk/): Sync users from DingTalk (钉钉) to Casdoor via the DingTalk API.
- [Lark syncer](https://casdoor.ai/vi/docs/syncer/Lark/): Sync users from Lark (Feishu) to Casdoor via the Lark Open Platform API.
